note: City of Norfolk park campground in a heavily shaded area between the Elkhorn River and a lagoon, with direct access to the Cowboy Trail. One ADA pad. The concrete pads and power pedestals are for RVs; tent campers use the tent sites. --Claude
summary: City page unreadable today (certificate error); its 2026-10-16 browser read confirms $28 pad+electric / $18 without, year-round with restrooms/showers closed mid-Oct to mid-Apr, dump station: fees, season, dump now manual. Pad count (18), amperage, showers and wifi not in the captured text, left derived. No booking engine named. Not waterfront stands. Pin is on the wrong bank of the Elkhorn.
flags: PIN ACROSS THE RIVER (~165 m): stored 42.00260,-97.42280 is on the SOUTH bank of the Elkhorn (beside the new development east of US-81); the campground pads are on the north bank, along the camp road between the river and the lagoon. Suggest 42.0039,-97.4238 (centre of the pads, from Esri imagery). Under 250 m but on the other side of a river with no crossing there.

WATERFRONT not waterfront stands: the Elkhorn here is ~90-120 m wide (river class). The pads are ~30-40 m from its north bank, behind a continuous belt of mature trees (the page itself says 'heavily shaded'), so neither open ground nor a clear view. The lagoon north of the camp road: NAIP NIR flood fill gives ~1.9 acres (east basin, beside the pads) + ~2.5 acres (north arm past the footbridge) = ~4.4 acres, under the ~5-acre line, so a pond with no pond-view; the camp road runs between most pads and the lagoon anyway.

BOOKING: the captured page text names no reservations, booking engine or first-come rule; nothing written. 'Concrete pads and power pedestals are intended for RVs. For tent camping only, please use tent sites.'
